text:
Emily: opened a PR to update the usage-tiering + metering migration guide for the v2 docs — includes new examples for parsing rate-limit headers and updated dashboard screenshots. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/456
Sam: nice. can you add a tiny SDK snippet that shows how to read the X-RateLimit headers? folks keep asking how to surface 'remaining' in their apps.
Emily: yep added both JS and Python examples in the PR body. JS snippet I added:
```js
// after a request with the Redwood SDK
const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-small', input: 'hi' })
const limit = res.headers['x-rate-limit-limit']
const remaining = res.headers['x-rate-limit-remaining']
const reset = res.headers['x-rate-limit-reset'] // unix epoch sec
console.log(`limit=${limit} remaining=${remaining} reset=${reset}`)
```
Sam: perfect. also include an example showing exponential backoff when remaining==0 — most customers want a snippet.
Emily: added a tiny retry helper and a note about 429 semantics (burst vs sustained).
Jordan: we should also call out tier differences in the migration guide (free/dev/pro/enterprise) — especially the burst window and metering granularity. Can you add a short table?
Emily: added table with columns: tier, per_minute_burst, steady_qps, metering_granularity. Also included a plain-language line: "Enterprise customers have per-project metering and daily aggregation; free/dev are per-account, per-hour."
Maya: quick product nit — change the wording from "per-minute" to "per-60s window" to match backend. Also add an example dashboard filter to show how teams can slice by project id.
Emily: updated wording & added a dashboard screenshot + query: 
```
metric: tokens_consumed
filters: project_id=proj_123, model=rwd-small
time_range: last_30d
```
Sam: small docs style note — can we keep SDK snippets < 12 lines? long snippets get noisy. maybe link to a gist for the full helper.
Emily: shortened the examples and linked to a gist with the backoff helper.
ci-bot: docs build passed — no broken links found ✅
Maya: looks good to me, added a short acceptance comment on the PR.
Jordan: LGTM from eng side, please squash + merge after legal signoff.
Emily: will hold merge for 1 hour to give legal a chance. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam: can you also add a short migration checklist at the top of the guide: 1) review tier differences 2) update dashboard filters 3) add alerts for budget thresholds 4) run token-cost audit
Emily: added checklist and an example alert rule snippet for Slack/email when spend > 80% of monthly budget.
Maya: great, merging workflow looks clear. Ping me if legal requests wording changes.
Emily: thanks — PR ready, will merge after green and legal ok.
